args.message:
Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

round_money previously used ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring claiming
banker's rounding. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so half-cent values round to
the nearest even cent, as required by FIN-212 and expected by
tests/test_money.py.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` rounded to cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while its docstring — and policy FIN-212 — require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g., `2.665` was rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Changes
- Switch the `rounding=` argument to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` and update the import.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (includes `tests/test_money.py`, which asserts both `2.675 -> 2.68` and `2.665 -> 2.66`).
